## manifest.yaml requirements (new as of Oct 27, 2026)

Every Stage 5 submission ZIP must include `manifest.yaml` at the zip root declaring exactly what is to be examined. Key structure (`schema_version: 2`):

- **`submission:`** — title, `stage: 5`
- **`coordinator:`** — `entry_point` (REQUIRED), `prompt_file` (optional, only if the coordinator itself is prompted), `dispatch: messages-api | subprocess | cli` (REQUIRED, cross-checked by the coordinator-purity scan)
- **`agents:`** — absorbs `agents.json` verbatim; each entry has `name`, `role` (coordinator | subagent | adversarial), `workflows`, `allowed_tools`, `reviews`, `isolated_context`
- **`workflows:`** — each with `name`, optional `sub_agent_entry_point`, and `steps` where every step has `prompt_file` (REQUIRED), `eval_files` (REQUIRED, at least 1), and `log_files` (optional only if the workflow declares a `log`); optional workflow-level `artifacts` (log, success_rate)
- **`punch_outs:`** — every human evacuation point with REQUIRED `evidence` files that must ship in the zip
- **`adversarial_review:`** — `reviewer_agent` must match an `agents[]` entry with `role: adversarial`, plus `evidence` (reviewer prompt, outputs, logs)
- **`version_control:`** — REQUIRED for Stage 5; exported evidence only (git-log.tsv, bundle, patches) — never `.git/`
- **`not_judged:`** — every unexamined file with a one-line reason; trailing-slash entries (e.g. `runs/`) bulk-exclude a directory

Path rules: root-relative, forward slashes, case-sensitive, no absolute paths, no `..`, and paths must match the zip contents exactly (wrapper-directory prefix is stripped).

Hard rejection rules (R1–R8): manifest at zip root; parseable with one coordinator and at least 1 workflow/step; every referenced path exists (cited-but-missing punch-out evidence is the most common failure); every file either referenced or in `not_judged`; no VCS directories; legacy agents.json must be folded into the manifest or excluded; shared log/eval files across steps are legal; `reviewer_agent` must name an adversarial agent; and every step needs log evidence (step `log_files` or workflow `log`).

The article also ships a ready-to-use packaging prompt (7 steps: inventory, classify, write manifest, validator rules, self-validate, zip, final report with SHA-256) — full text is in the extracted file above if you want it pasted anywhere.
